name: Wave pipeline
description: Builds one ticket: the Builder writes the failing test first, then the code; the Code Reviewer, who only reads, lists every finding in its first review and later rounds only check that each was fixed or declined for a reason that holds (bounded); the Integrator opens a draft merge request; the operator pulls the branch and runs the CI tasks locally (bugs go back to the Builder); the Doc Auditor traces the requirements in the ticket's own file and notes there what the plan documents should say, for the wave's ship run to apply, escalating a PRD gap or a wrong design instead of finishing; the Integrator then marks the merge request ready with code and documents.

task.description: The ticket: title, slice, files and acceptance tests. It must name its feature on a line "Feature: <slug>" (the plan is in docs/plans/<slug>/) until issues carry it

summary.description: What you built or changed, and the result of the whole suite you ran last: how many tests passed, or which failed

test_command.description: The exact command that ran the project's whole suite

responses.description: One answer for each finding of the code review (R1, R2 ...) and each item the operator sent back (manual_test, doc_audit) that your task lists

note.description: fixed: what you changed and the test that proves it; declined: why

findings.description: Every finding of your first review, numbered R1, R2 ...; a later review copies them unchanged

checks.description: A later review's check of each finding and each item the operator sent back

merge_request_url.description: The url the tool returned; empty only when opening the draft merge request was rejected or its approval expired

branch.description: The branch the tool returned; empty only when opening the draft merge request was rejected or its approval expired

nodes.message:
{{$draft := .state.integrator_draft}}{{if and $draft $draft.branch $draft.merge_request_url}}Pull branch {{$draft.branch}} and run the CI tasks locally (the project's build, lint and test commands), then try the change by hand. Draft merge request: {{$draft.merge_request_url}}
Approve when it works. Reject with the bugs you found: they go back to the Builder.{{else}}The draft merge request is missing: opening it was rejected or its approval expired, so there is no branch to test. Reject this step to send the ticket back to the Builder; the draft merge request is then opened again for your approval.{{end}}

left_out.description: The plan documents the tool answer lists as left out of the merge request; omit when there are none
